versions.changelog: - Switched from Big Five (BFI-44) to Myers-Briggs Type Indicator (MBTI) personality test.

Personality Test (Big Five) 1.0.0

- Initial release with a complete Big Five Inventory (BFI-44) assessment for AI agents.
- Allows users to rate themselves on 44 statements and automatically calculates all trait scores.
- Provides step-by-step instructions for rating, reverse-scoring, averaging, and interpreting results.
- Outputs results in a clear, formatted summary with trait scores and levels.
